plan: Given my value of $34, I aim to bid just below it to maximize profit if I win. Since bids are in $0.1 increments, I will bid $33.9. This strategy balances a competitive bid against the risk of overpaying. If I win, I pay the third-highest bid, maximizing profit.

Given my private value of $7, I aim to bid slightly above the expected average bid of the others to win the item without overpaying. Assuming rational bidders, they will bid close to their value. I will bid slightly above $7 to maximize profit if others have lower values. Bidding too high risks negative profit.

Given my value of $13, I aim to bid slightly above the expected third-highest bid to maximize profit. Since values range from $0 to $49, the average bid is around $24.5. Rational bidders will bid close to their values. To win, I should bid slightly above the lower third of the range, aiming for a bid of $5. This ensures I pay less than my value if I win, maximizing my profit.
